verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow drops below the fine print, so the legal line outranks the urgency hook. It also leaves dead space above the headline, and its centered product and CTA don't share an axis with the left-aligned copy. B keeps the original order and left edge, with the CTA grouped under the copy and the legal line at the bottom, but its eyebrow is shrunk to near-illegible size, the headline sits half on the circle, and there are large empty gaps around the floating product.
